name: Ando Aren
source:
Once lead a group of delinquents in Shibuya. Ando acts on instinct rather than thinking and can't leave troubled people alone. To help vulnerable people, he frantically studied and passed the bar exam, but now that he's actually a lawyer he's fed up with only getting pointless requests.

[Translated from [url=https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/260728t]profile[/url]]
